- [ASSISTANT_SAID] On-cycle compensation refers to the regular salary and benefits that an employee is entitled to receive as per the company's standard compensation cycle, usually on a monthly or bi-monthly basis.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Off-cycle compensation refers to any additional benefits or bonuses that an employee may receive outside of the regular compensation cycle, such as a signing bonus, performance-based bonuses, or stock options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is important for HR to manage both types of compensation effectively to ensure that employees are fairly compensated for their work and that the company's budget remains balanced.
